boundaries: All application queries and tests use local synthetic evidence; institutional SSO, real applicant data, production scale, actual hiring quality and payroll are not established.

The request cohort is selected by Eastern join dates; full known outcomes/contact for that cohort are observed through the generated timestamp. Feedback submission dates, UTC work dates and current semester staffing remain separate measures.
Only explicit, student-owned helper/session-linked feedback contributes to a helper rating. Counts, sample diversity and durations are evidence, not a universal quality rank.
Approved plans and conditional +/-1 position costs do not establish required staffing, observation coverage, attendance, remaining spend authority or savings.
Automated WCAG and geometry checks cover exercised states, not universal accessibility or physical-device behavior.
Older real-provider receipts retain their own dates and application digests. No new provider result is implied.
